extension.summary: Access your content from Easynews and Debrid Clouds.
extension.description: This add-on is intended for advanced Kodi users only. You must own the content of any media you play through this addon. This is an English language only add-on.
extension.disclaimer: The author of this addon does not host any of the content which is found and has no affiliation with any of the content providers.
extension.news:
[v2.0.16.1023]: * Preserve Kodi resume points for direct TorBox cloud-storage playback by resolving files through Kodi's stable plugin URL.
[v2.0.16.1021]: * Add restore-default actions for the OMDb and TheIntroDB API keys in Accounts settings.
[v2.0.16.1020]: * Add local decade and provider artwork for navigator menus, with poster art support where available.
[v2.0.16.1019]: * Try IntroDB's app segments endpoint before the TheIntroDB.org fallback and parse single segment objects from either endpoint.
[v2.0.16.1018]: * Add TheIntroDB lookups with a shipped default API key, skip intro/recap buttons, and next-episode timing support for English episode playback.
[v2.0.16.1017]: * Add optional AIOStreams manifest support for TorBox Usenet Search cached streams, with direct TorBox Search API fallback when unset. * Trust ID-matched AIOStreams TorBox Usenet Search rows so official prefix text in release names does not hide valid cached results.
[v2.0.16.1016]: * Mix TorBox Usenet Search rows into the normal result sort and display them as TB USENET/NZB.
[v2.0.16.1015]: * Add TorBox cached Usenet Search support with movie/episode toggles and a no-results retry option.
[v2.0.16.1014]: * Enable TorBox Search Cloud Storage by default and migrate existing Fen Light English installs to turn it on without changing TorBox authorization.
[v2.0.16.1013]: * Add TorBox Web Download cloud support so web-hosted uploads can be scraped, browsed, resolved, and deleted alongside TorBox torrent and usenet cloud items. * Prefer TorBox file short names during cloud scraping so webhoster folder prefixes do not block title matching.
[v2.0.15.1012]: * Refresh the Trakt and Real-Debrid QR-backed device-auth flow with styled Trakt QR cards, direct activation QR targets where available, and the latest English auth prompt behavior.
INFO: For latest changes see Changelog within Tools of add-on.
